messages:
Alex (PM): quick sketch dropped — compact pool row that surfaces min/max, a tiny burst badge, and an SLO micro-toggle. goal: users make a safe pick without opening the modal. Zoe (Designer): i like it. suggestion: show a one-word guardrail tag when SLO is aggressive, e.g. "At risk" with hover details. keep the row height single-line. Raj (Frontend): hover-only is no-go for keyboard/screenreader. make the tag focusable and provide `aria-describedby` for details. also dark-mode burst badge needs higher contrast. Diego (SRE): when burst == 0 show inline alert: "No burst — spikes may queue" and action "Pick pool with burst". dedicated customers behind flag can see exact headroom numbers. Alex (PM): copy options: "At risk" vs "May queue". which is clearer? Zoe (Designer): "May queue" reads like behavior; "At risk" is a state. prefer "May queue" for clarity. show tooltip: "Requests may queue under sudden traffic spikes" Raj (Frontend): accessibility snippet: ```
No burst 94 requests may queue
``` Ensure CTA is in tab order and tag has `aria-expanded` for details. Diego (SRE): also recommend showing a tiny relative latency hint next to burst, e.g. "~+15% p95 (est.)". label as estimated to avoid overpromising. Zoe (Designer): will update mock: one-line row, "May queue" copy, relative impact hint, focusable guardrail tag, collapsed steppers under 420px, and presets for SLO (low/med/high). Alex (PM): great. can Diego/Raj give rough effort estimates by EOD? i'll attach the mock and create a feature flag ticket. ops-bot: created INF-5421 (mini-pool-guardrail) assigned to @Diego, label: ux-rollout :white_check_mark: Diego (SRE): will add ETA to INF-5421 by 5pm. Raj (Frontend): will add frontend task estimates and prototype notes. Alex (PM): thanks team 94 aiming for next sprint if estimates look good :thumbsup:
